summary: Mobile frontend tested end-to-end for Comment Replies & Delete feature on Expo web preview. Verified all 7 scenarios from the review request on the shared backend using two freshly registered users (test_cmta owner, test_cmtb non-owner). Reply inline composer prefills with '@username ', threads auto-expand on send, 'View N replies'/'Hide replies' toggle works, Delete appears ONLY on own comments, confirm card (comment-delete-confirm) + confirm-btn removes the item, deleting a top-level comment with 1 reply decrements the count by 2 on BOTH surfaces (CommentSheet for posts and the inline Video screen comment list). Count label on video screen correctly updates between '{n} Comments' values. No parity issues found; both surfaces call the same backend endpoints and behave identically.

design_issues.screen: Video screen - comment delete confirm Modal
issues: Minor: when the top-level comment being deleted HAS replies, the Modal body on video/[id].tsx correctly reads 'This also removes its replies.'; confirmed matches CommentSheet behavior.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN-Web deprecation warning observed in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not caused by this feature but surfaces on screens tested. Reference: appears when the Modal / confirm overlay mounts.
Non-blocking RN-Web deprecation warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Pre-existing, unrelated to this feature.

critical_code_review_comments: CommentSheet.tsx: `onReply` resolves topId as `c.parent_id || c.id` and prefills `@username ` — matches the single-level thread spec. Good.

CommentSheet.tsx: delete handler strips both the row and `parent_id === c.id` on top-level deletion, matching backend `removed` semantics. onCountChange(-(r.removed || 1)) correctly uses server-reported removal count.
video/[id].tsx: Same thread shape (nested author object) handled correctly; comment count decrements via `cur.comments_count - (r.removed || 1)` with Math.max(0, ...) guard. Good.

Error paths in CommentSheet.tsx `submit`/`del` swallow errors silently (comments on `// swallow`). Consider surfacing a toast on failure for parity with video screen's Alert.alert — minor UX nit, not blocking.
video/[id].tsx uses Alert.alert for comment post/delete failures but a Modal for the confirm step — mixed UX styles. Not blocking.
test_credentials: test_cmta / PIN 1234 (comment owner); test_cmtb / PIN 1234 (non-owner). Both auto-purge on backend restart (test_ prefix).
seed_data_creation: Created two test accounts (test_cmta, test_cmtb), one post by test_cmta with id 9bf44855-0a3b-4884-83de-40d8a5f32fb6 and one top-level comment on existing video 55680188-e05f-4ccd-9cfe-5f700b30c96c. All auto-purged on next backend restart.
